note: probe_host is set only where urlProbe sends the request to a host other than the displayed one, which discloses the username to that host. method is the verb Sherlock uses: explicit request_method, else HEAD for status_code and GET otherwise. A HEAD probe carries no body, so the WAF fingerprint cannot fire on it.

fp_exclusions_measured.source: the upstream false_positive_exclusions list as read for the 0.16.1 capability audit, 52 names; it is regenerated upstream daily, so this copy dates from the audit

url_without_username_slot.source: every site whose url field at 9100f9d carries no {} slot, read by the fixer on 2026-10-28 from the same data.json (sha256 above). Sherlock writes that url as url_user on every non-Illegal row, so the CSV cell does not contain the username, and a Claimed row says the name is taken in a registration check rather than that a profile page exists (CAPABILITIES.md A1.5)
